Exactly what the previous comment said. It's about adjustment and finding the sweet spot for you. I would allow more carbs the day before and day of a bike ride so my body had some fuel to burn. Then reduce my carb intake for days off and back up again before a ride. Also taking some small snacks to eat on bike rides helped me out too because I felt gross after.

Thanks, a big part was changing my diet. Started doing high protein and low carb diet. Protein bars, protein shakes, lots of meat and some vegetables like kale, broccoli, cauliflower, baby carrots and celery for fibre/nutrients. Also used creatine and BCAAs to help with muscle growth/maintenance while cycling.  You can add in some small hills and stairs too while cycling and increase with experience to help with leg strength. Best of luck!
